# Tolj Commercial Real Estate

> > Tolj Commercial Real Estate provides commercial property services in Pasadena, Los Angeles, Glendale, and surrounding areas, specializing in multifamily, medical office, retail, and distressed property investments.

Led by Mike Tolj, the firm offers landlord and seller representation, property acquisition, leasing services, and investment consulting across Southern California. The site features case studies, investment strategies, and market insights for commercial real estate investors and property owners in the greater Los Angeles area.
